controles.affirmation: Judiciaire : jugement Propel Fuels de 833 M$ le 5 aout 2025 (604,9 compensatoires + 195 punitifs + 33,3 d'interets), interets post-jugement a 10%/an, provision 928 M$ au 30/06/2026 contre 867 M$ au 31/12/2025, appel en cours (memoire du 10 juillet 2026)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 12 : "On October 16, 2024, a jury returned a verdict against Phillips 66 Company for $604.9 million in compensatory damages and issued a willfulness finding... On August 5, 2025, the Propel Court entered a final judgment against Phillips 66 Company in the amount of $833 million. The judgment includes the $604.9 million jury verdict, $195 million of exemplary damages, and $33.3 million of pre-judgment interest at 7%. From the date of final judgment, post-judgment interest of 10% is accruing... On November 14, 2025, Phillips 66 Company filed its Notice of Appeal, which has been assigned to Division Two of the First District Court of Appeal. On July 10, 2026, Phillips 66 Company filed its opening brief..." ; "The accrued amounts totaling $928 million and $867 million as of June 30, 2026, and December 31, 2025, respectively..." ; "Until the final resolution of this matter, we may be exposed to losses in excess of the amount recorded, and such amounts may have a material adverse effect on our financial position."

controles.affirmation: Judiciaire penal : acte d'accusation federal de novembre 2024 pour violations du Clean Water Act a Carson, solde le 20 janvier 2026 par un accord de poursuite differee avec 8 M$ de penalite et des audits de conformite
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "In November 2024, Phillips 66 Company received an indictment from a federal grand jury in the United States District Court for the Central District of California alleging two counts of negligently violating the Clean Water Act and four counts of knowingly violating the Clean Water Act at the Carson portion of its Los Angeles Refinery... On January 20, 2026, a Deferred Prosecution Agreement was entered obligating Phillips 66 to pay an $8 million penalty to the U.S. Government and $28,572 in restitution to the Los Angeles County Sanitation Districts, update certain policies and training related to Clean Water Act compliance, and conduct auditing relating to Clean Water Act compliance at two operating facilities."

controles.affirmation: Reglementaire : la loi californienne SBx 1-2 autorise une marge maximale de raffinage assortie d'une penalite et permet a la CEC d'encadrer le calendrier des arrets de maintenance ; effets potentiellement significatifs
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "...(i) authorizes the establishment of a maximum gross gasoline refining margin (maximum margin) and the imposition of a financial penalty for profits above the maximum margin... (iv) authorizes the CEC to regulate the timing and other aspects of facility turnaround and other maintenance activities in certain instances... which may be material to our results of operations, financial condition, profitability and cash flows."

controles.affirmation: Depreciation WRB de 948 M$ au T3 2025 "avant d'en racheter les 50% restants TROIS SEMAINES PLUS TARD"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "...we recorded a $948 million before-tax impairment... to reduce the carrying value of our then existing 50% equity interest in WRB to its fair value of $1.3 billion as of September 30, 2025... As a result of the acquisition, effective October 1, 2025, we began consolidating the financial results of WRB." Note 5 : "On October 1, 2025, we acquired and began consolidating the financial results of WRB". De plus, la depreciation decoule directement de l'accord de rachat : "In the third quarter of 2025, we identified impairment indicators... as a result of our definitive agreement to acquire the remaining 50% equity interest in WRB for a purchase price that was below the carrying value..."
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par : "une depreciation de 948 M$ mesuree au 30 septembre 2025, declenchee par l'accord de rachat lui-meme, le rachat des 50% restants prenant effet le lendemain, 1er octobre 2025".

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 1 : resultat T2 2026 de 3 847 M$ contre 877 M$, Raffinage 3 062 M$ contre 359 M$, Midstream + M&S +5%, crack 3:2:1 de 21,65 a 41,63 $/b, debit +6%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The composite 3:2:1 market crack spread for our business increased to an average of $41.63 per barrel during the second quarter of 2026, from an average of $21.65 per barrel during the second quarter of 2025." Segments : Refining income before income taxes 3 062 / 359 ; Midstream 785 / 731 ; M&S 583 / 571 (1 368 / 1 302 = +5,1%). Crude oil processed 1 919 / 1 810 (+6,0%), capacity utilization 96%.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 2 : T1 2026, 2,3 Mds$ consommes par l'exploitation dont ~3 Mds$ d'appels de garantie, dette 27 124 M$, ratio dette/capital 48%, 0,8 Md$ de lignes disponibles, 778 M$ verses aux actionnaires
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T1 2026 : "In the first quarter of 2026, we reported earnings of $207 million. In response to the sharp increases in commodity prices and to preserve liquidity, we had net debt borrowings of $7.7 billion... We used available cash to fund operating activities of $2.3 billion, capital expenditures and investments of $582 million, dividend payments to common stockholders of $509 million and repurchases of our common stock of $269 million... as well as, the funding of approximately $3 billion of cash collateral on derivative positions. As of March 31, 2026, we had $5.2 billion of cash and cash equivalents and $0.8 billion of total committed capacity available under our credit facilities." Financial Indicators : Total debt 27 124 / 19 716, Percent of total debt to capital 48% / 39%.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 3 : dette 20 565 M$ au 30/06/2026 contre 19 716 M$ au 31/12/2025, ratio inchange a 39%, cible de 17 Mds$ fin 2027, dette x2,3 depuis mi-2016 (8,9 Mds$), effectifs 14 800 a 12 600
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Financial Indicators : Cash 4 099 / 1 116, Total debt 20 565 / 19 716, Percent of total debt to capital 39% / 39, floating-rate 6% / 2 ; "We are targeting reductions of total debt to $17 billion and reductions of our debt-to-capital ratio by the end of 2027." ; "...$7.3 billion of cash from operations. We had net debt repayments of $6.7 billion". Serie kpis-haut PSX : dette Q2-2016 = 8,9 Mds$ (20,6/8,9 = x2,31) ; effectifs FY2016 14 800, FY2025 12 600 (10-K FY2025 : "approximately 12,600 employees").

controles.affirmation: Les rachats trimestriels DEPASSAIENT 800 M$ DE FACON REGULIERE entre le T3 2022 et le T4 2024
controles.verbatim_source: Serie kpis-haut PSX (rachats d'actions, M$) : Q3-2022 694 ; Q4-2022 753 ; Q1-2023 800 ; Q2-2023 1 309 ; Q3-2023 752 ; Q4-2023 1 153 ; Q1-2024 1 164 ; Q2-2024 840 ; Q3-2024 800 ; Q4-2024 647. Seuls 4 trimestres sur 10 depassent strictement 800 M$, et les deux trimestres bornes de la periode citee (694 et 647) sont sous ce seuil.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par : "les rachats trimestriels se sont situes entre 647 et 1 309 M$ entre le T3 2022 et le T4 2024, avec une moyenne d'environ 890 M$". La suite ("depuis six trimestres compris entre 247 et 419 M$") est exacte.

controles.affirmation: Resultat 2025 de 4 403 M$ porte par 1,9 Md$ de plus-value Allemagne/Autriche et 1 Md$ sur Coop, moins 948 M$ de depreciation WRB ; pres de 1,4 Md$ de depreciations en 2024-2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Net income attributable to Phillips 66 for the year ended December 31, 2025, was $4,403 million, compared with $2,117 million... primarily due to a before-tax aggregate gain of $1.9 billion associated with the partial sale of Germany and Austria Marketing in December 2025, improved realized refining margins... as well as a before-tax gain of $1 billion associated with the sale of our investment in Coop... partially offset by a before-tax impairment of $948 million... related to our equity method investment in WRB" ; "$79 million related to our equity investment in an NGL pipeline in Texas in the fourth quarter of 2025" ; "$224 million recognized in the second quarter of 2024 related to certain Midstream gathering and processing assets in Texas and a before-tax impairment of $163 million recognized in the first quarter of 2024 related to certain crude oil processing and logistics assets in California". Total 948+79+224+163 = 1 414 M$.
controles.correction_proposee: La citation de l'ATT elide par "..." la mention "improved realized refining margins, primarily driven by higher market crack spreads", qui est un facteur favorable. Ellipse signalee, mais gagnerait a etre restituee.

controles.correction_proposee: Detail : le 10-K ecrit "Taxes other than income taxes increased $462 million in 2025, primarily due to the expiration of the Biodiesel Blender Tax Credit" ; l'ATT parle de "charge fiscale", ce qui peut se lire comme impot sur les benefices. Preciser "taxes autres que l'impot sur les benefices".
